test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Teenu wrote a congratulatory letter.

options.text: A congratulatory letter written by Teenu.
A congratulatory letter is written by Teenu.
A congratulatory letter was written by Teenu.
A congratulatory letter had been written by Teenu.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"Teenu wrote a congratulatory letter." **needs to be converted into **passive voice.**
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the **subject** of the passive sentence.
 
• The correct passive form is **"A congratulatory letter was written by Teenu."**
 
• This ensures that the action of writing is emphasized over the doer** (Teenu).**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

Correct Sentence: ***"A congratulatory letter was written by Teenu."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "A congratulatory letter written by Teenu." is incorrect as it is incomplete.
 
• **Option 2:** "A congratulatory letter is written by Teenu." is incorrect as it implies present tense.
 
• **Option 4:** "A congratulatory letter had been written by Teenu." is incorrect as it implies past perfect tense.
